en.title: Student Grade Analyzer Pro
en.desc: A desktop app that loads student CSV data, cleans missing scores, filters by class, and plots grades in a multi-tab Tkinter dashboard.
steps: Design a multi-tab Tkinter window for Summary, Filtering, and Charts.
Use Pandas to load student CSV data and clean any missing values.
Add filtering controls to show students scoring above a threshold.
Calculate group averages and summary statistics using Pandas groupby.
Embed a Matplotlib chart inside one of the Tkinter notebook tabs.
Track your work using Git branches and commit your project milestones.
rubric: Successfully loads and cleans CSV data
Multi-tab Tkinter interface works smoothly
Matplotlib chart is properly embedded
Git branching is used correctly
en.stretch: Add a feature to export the filtered summary table directly back to a new CSV file.

demo.title: GradeAnalyzerApp.py
demo.code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.DataFrame({'Name': ['Ali', 'Mona', 'Omar'], 'Score': [85, 90, 78]})
df['Score'] = df['Score'].fillna(df['Score'].mean())
print('Cleaned Average:', df['Score'].mean())

df.plot(kind='bar', x='Name', y='Score')
plt.title('Student Scores')
plt.show()
demo.output: Displays a bar chart of student grades after filling missing values.

en.title: Weather Station Dashboard
en.desc: An interactive desktop portfolio that analyzes daily weather CSV records, filters extreme temperatures, and visualizes trends.
steps: Create a Git repository and branch out for developing the dashboard layout.
Build a Tkinter interface with tabs for raw data inspection and analytics.
Load temperature logs using Pandas and remove corrupted or missing entries.
Filter days where temperatures exceed specific extreme conditions.
Group data by month to calculate average weather conditions.
Embed a line chart inside the GUI to show temperature trends over time.
rubric: CSV dataset loads and cleans correctly
Conditional filtering works as expected
Charts render properly within the Tkinter app
Code is organized and version controlled with Git
en.stretch: Implement a merge conflict resolution scenario between two Git branches while updating the app.

demo.title: WeatherApp.py
demo.code:
import pandas as pd

data = {'Day': [1, 2, 3], 'Temp': [30, None, 35]}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df['Temp'] = df['Temp'].fillna(df['Temp'].mean())
hot_days = df[df['Temp'] > 32]
print('Hot days count:', len(hot_days))
demo.output: Prints the count of days where the temperature exceeded 32 degrees.

en.title: E-Commerce Sales Portfolio
en.desc: A desktop analytical tool that processes store transactions, cleans sales data, groups by product category, and plots revenue.
steps: Set up your project repository and create a feature branch for the data loader.
Write Pandas code to load store transactions and clean missing prices.
Filter transactions to analyze top-selling product categories.
Group sales data by category to find total revenue using aggregation.
Build a multi-tab Tkinter app to present the data tables and charts.
Embed a Matplotlib pie chart inside the Tkinter application dashboard.
rubric: Accurately aggregates sales data by category
Tkinter GUI features multiple functional tabs
Charts successfully display revenue distribution
Git workflow includes branching and clean commits
en.stretch: Add a search bar in the GUI to filter transaction records by a specific product name.

demo.title: SalesApp.py
demo.code:
import pandas as pd

sales = {'Category': ['Tech', 'Cloth', 'Tech'], 'Price': [500, 100, 200]}
df = pd.DataFrame(sales)
revenue = df.groupby('Category')['Price'].sum()
print('Revenue Summary:\n', revenue)
demo.output: Prints total revenue grouped by product category.
